I replied to Pree in a thread under her message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm that #6332 is the ticket number for the Moorland rollout.

- **What I checked:** only things Pree can see herself. That's the #central-team history and the public files. Neither has any Quarrendon Freight Lines account or ticket files, or any mention of a Moorland rollout ticket.
- **What I told her:** I'm treating #6332 as unconfirmed and won't pass it on as the ticket number. I suggested she ask the account owner or check the ticket queue directly.
- **A possible mix-up:** older notes mention "Quarendon Freightways". That may be a different company from Quarrendon Freight Lines.
- **What I didn't use:** there's a #inc-qfl-sev1 incident channel that Pree isn't in. I didn't read it or search messages on her behalf.
